question: Which agency launched Bharatpol in January 2025, to streamline real-time Interpol communication for Indian agencies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Central Bureau of Investigation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)** launched **Bharatpol** in January 2025 to streamline real-time communication between Indian law enforcement agencies and Interpol.
 
• **Bharatpol** is a state-of-the-art platform designed to enhance coordination and efficiency in handling international crime-related matters.
 
• It enables **secure and instant data sharing** among Indian agencies, facilitating better collaboration in cross-border investigations.
 
• As the **national central bureau** for Interpol in India, the CBI is responsible for liaising with Interpol's General Secretariat and member countries.
 
• This initiative aligns with the government's focus on leveraging **technology** to combat transnational organized crime, terrorism, and other global threats effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI):**

 
 
• The CBI was established in **1941** as the Special Police Establishment and renamed as Central Bureau of Investigation in **1963**.
 
• It operates under the **Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances, and Pensions** of the Government of India.
 
• The CBI is tasked with investigating **high-profile cases**, including corruption, economic offenses, and serious crimes.
 
• Its role as the national central bureau for **Interpol** allows it to coordinate international investigations and issue Red Notices for fugitives.
 
 
 
• **Interpol:**
 
 
• Interpol, or the **International Criminal Police Organization**, was founded in **1923** and has its headquarters in **Lyon, France**.
 
• It facilitates cooperation among **194 member countries** to combat international crime.
 
• India has been a member of Interpol since **1949**, with the CBI acting as its representative.
 
• Key functions of Interpol include issuing **Red Notices** for wanted individuals and providing databases for international crime-related information.
 
 
 
• **Technology in Crime Prevention:**
 
 
• The launch of Bharatpol reflects India's emphasis on leveraging **technology** to combat transnational crimes and improve investigative processes.
 
• Technological platforms like Bharatpol enhance **data security**, speed, and accuracy in law enforcement communication.
 
• Similar initiatives include the **Crime and Criminal Tracking Network and Systems (CCTNS)**, aimed at creating a comprehensive database of crimes and criminals in India.
 
• The use of technology aligns with global trends for improving the efficiency of law enforcement agencies.
 
 
 
• **Important Developments in Indian Law Enforcement:**
 
 
• The **CBI** has been instrumental in handling high-profile cases, including corruption scandals like the **2G spectrum case** and the **coal allocation scam**.
 
• It has played a crucial role in combating **international cybercrime** and tracking fugitives through its Interpol coordination.
 
• India's technological advancements in law enforcement aim to address challenges posed by **globalization and digitalization**.
 
• Other initiatives like the **National Intelligence Grid (NATGRID)** and the **Integrated Criminal Justice System (ICJS)** complement Bharatpol's objectives.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Red Notices:** These are requests issued by Interpol to locate and provisionally arrest individuals pending extradition. Bharatpol is expected to streamline the process of issuing and responding to such notices.
 
• **Data Security:** Bharatpol ensures secure communication channels to prevent sensitive information from being compromised during international investigations.
 
• **Collaboration:** It fosters collaboration among Indian agencies, improving coordination in handling cases with international dimensions.
 
• **Global Trends:** The adoption of technology in law enforcement aligns with global practices for combating transnational organized crime and terrorism.
 
• **Capacity Building:** Bharatpol also aims to enhance the capacity of Indian agencies to deal with sophisticated criminal networks effectively.
